title: Hot Cross Buns Picnic with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
description:
Sing along to Hot Cross Buns at an autumn picnic! Three warm buns hop out of Lulu's picnic basket, and they hop again on "one a penny, two a penny". The puppy and the little turtle join in as the sun goes down, and there is a bun for everyone.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (traditional, 1798).
